key.maidcuriosmanager.open_manager_in_ma: Open Curio Manager in Maid GUI
Master switch. When off: the hotkey stops responding and the maid GUI entry is hidden. This only controls this mod; Touhou Little Maid's own 'enable_maid_curios' option is unaffected.
